name: Rendering Pipeline and Configuration
text:
# Rendering Pipeline and Configuration

Also called: GaussianRasterizer Setup, Rasterization Configuration

## Overview
The Rendering Pipeline and Configuration family manages the data preparation, camera context, and orchestration required to invoke the [3D Gaussian Splatting differentiable rasterizer](#2813-3d-gaussian-splatting-differentiable-rasterizer.md). It solves the problem of translating learned 3D Gaussian primitives and camera parameters into a valid state for the [CUDA](#3671-dual-contouring-2d-cuda.md) kernel, ensuring mutual exclusivity of input representations and correct projection geometry. It differs from its siblings by providing the high-level orchestration and configuration structures rather than the low-level kernel logic or specific optimization variants.

## Shared principles
All components in this family operate on the principle of strict input validation and context encapsulation. The pipeline ensures that exactly one color representation ([Spherical Harmonics](#5603-spherical-harmonics.md) or pre-computed RGB) and exactly one covariance representation (parametric scales/rotations or pre-computed 3D covariance) are active. The configuration structure encapsulates camera intrinsics, extrinsics, and rasterization flags, passing them as a single context object to the rasterizer to avoid redundant computation in the rendering loop.

## Subtopics

### [GaussianRasterizer Initialization and Input Validation](2923-gaussianrasterizer-initialization-and-input-validation.md)
Prepares input tensors by enforcing mutual exclusivity constraints and normalizing missing data into empty tensors to prevent undefined behavior during the forward pass.

### [GaussianRasterizationSettings](2924-gaussianrasterizationsettings.md)
A configuration data structure encapsulating camera parameters, background color, and rasterization flags, serving as the bridge between scene state and the CUDA kernel.

### [Gaussian Splatting Rendering Pipeline](3415-gaussian-splatting-rendering-pipeline.md)
Orchestrates the final stage of rendering, converting 3D Gaussians into a 2D image by handling covariance reconstruction, projection, [SH evaluation](#3848-spherical-harmonics-evaluation.md), and invoking the rasterizer.

## Background
The rendering pipeline and configuration structures are integral to the implementation of 3D [Gaussian Splatting](#946-gaussian-splatting.md) [S1, S3, S4]. They were developed to support the differentiable rasterization backend, allowing gradients to flow back to Gaussian parameters during training [S2, S4]. The specific validation logic and settings structure are derived from the standard PyTorch implementation of the 3D Gaussian Splatting rasterizer [S1, S2, unofficial].
